residualObservations.subject: MutationEnvelope validation on no-op AddDependencyAsync / RemoveDependencyAsync paths
residualObservations.detail: In AddDependencyAsync and RemoveDependencyAsync, the 'edge already in desired state' no-op success path returns MutationResult(Success: true) without first validating the MutationEnvelope. This may allow a malformed Actor/Source/ChangeId envelope to return success when no state change is required. Claude explicitly classified this as MINOR, NON-BLOCKING, NO DATA-INTEGRITY ISSUE, NO ARCHITECTURE ISSUE, DOES NOT WARRANT FIX REQUIRED.
